title: Gembul Diet
subject: a family in Kemayoran whose fat orange cat Gembul is put on a vet-ordered diet, and every member keeps secretly feeding him fried tempe until the next weigh-in shows he gained half a kilo
caption: Betawi tanjidor brass party pop, a festive Jakarta street brass band sound. Wailing clarinet lead, sliding trombone, bouncing tuba bass line, march bass drum and snare, jangling tambourine. Live loose brass-band mix with open-air feel. Male baritone with a rowdy Jakarta street-party delivery, group chant on the hook. 132 BPM, B-flat major. Rowdy, funny, festive. No autotune, no trap beat, no EDM drop, no synth brass, no dangdut kendang.
lyrics:
[Intro - tanjidor brass fanfare]

[Verse 1]
Kata dokter hewan di Kemayoran
Gembul kegendutan, harus diet
Makan pagi sama sore aja
Nggak boleh ngemil apa-apa

[Pre-Chorus]
Tapi Gembul ngeong di dapur
Matanya bulat kayak kelereng

[Chorus]
Gembul diet, Gembul diet
Tempe goreng jatuh sendiri
Gembul diet, Gembul diet
Siapa yang kasih tadi

[Verse 2]
Bapak bilang bukan dia
Ibu bilang cuma sedikit
Adik ngumpet di bawah meja
Tangannya bau minyak

[Bridge - trombone solo]
Timbang lagi minggu depan
Naik setengah kilo

[Chorus]
Gembul diet, Gembul diet
Dokter geleng-geleng kepala
Gembul diet, Gembul diet
Satu rumah ikut diet

[Outro - brass band fades]
